name: Void
description: A towering figure with an exposed brain watches from beyond the living wall. Its stillness is more terrible than movement.

name: Slan
description: A dark, winged figure rises above the ceremony. Her voice seems to reach you through your own blood.

name: Ubik
description: A small floating figure peers through round lenses. Around it, memories take shapes they never had.

name: Conrad
description: A squat, silent presence stands among the folds of flesh. The air around it feels heavy and sick.

name: Femto
description: A black, falcon-shaped presence stands apart from the others. The distance to it seems greater than the field itself.
